dedupe_keys.name: cittaclima map of climate risk in italian cities legambiente

description: CittàClima is the observatory of the Italian environmental association Legambiente on climate impacts in Italian cities. Its central map of climate risk in Italian cities records extreme weather events and their damage, and the counts shown on the home page when read were 1,347 municipalities hit, 2,927 events with damage, 1,055 stoppages of infrastructure, 1,455 floodings from intense rain and 356 river overflows. The site also offers a section on good adaptation practices, documents and media, news on events such as drought and the state of Alpine glaciers, and a map section for the EU LIFE A_GreeNet project, which aims to make cities on the central Adriatic coast more resilient through soil recovery, urban forests and green areas, green roofs and walls, and the delivery of sustainable energy and climate action plans. Access to the map is free online; no licence is stated on the page read. Caveats: events are compiled by an association from news and local sources, so coverage and damage detail vary, and the map loads by script. Coverage is Italy. It supports historical event analysis and exposure studies of roads, rail, power and water infrastructure disrupted by floods, storms and heat, and the choice of nature-based adaptation; related records are the Italian Civil Protection maps and dashboards and the Oppla nature-based solutions repository.
